Apply to jobs without losing control

An AI agent that finds matching roles, tailors your resume honestly, rehearses each application in a dry run, and only submits what you approve.

8steps
0made-up skills
100%you approve
Step 1 of 8

Upload your resume

The agent reads a PDF, DOCX or text resume and lists every role it found, so you can check it before anything else happens.

  • Parses roles, education and skills
  • Nothing is guessed: blank fields pause and ask you
  • Profile is stored encrypted
Step 2 of 8

Choose how careful it is

A pre-flight checklist confirms setup, then you pick a mode. Review mode only submits applications you approve one by one.

  • Review mode: you approve each submission
  • Auto-apply needs a separate typed consent with limits
  • Optional Claude model; off means templates built only from your resume
Step 3 of 8

See matched jobs

It pulls openings from the job boards you configure, screens them against your criteria and ranks the ones worth applying to.

  • 14 discovered, 9 meet criteria, 8 ready for review
  • Flags suspicious postings (e.g. prompt-injection text)
  • Shows missing qualifications up front
Step 4 of 8

Understand the match

Every job gets a transparent, weighted match score with what is missing, so you know why it was picked.

  • Skills, experience, education, responsibilities
  • Honest about gaps instead of padding the resume
  • Clearly not an employer ATS score
Step 5 of 8

Tailor without inventing

The resume is reordered to put the most relevant evidence first. Skills you don’t have are never added.

  • Reorders bullets and skills only
  • Lists remaining gaps openly
  • Generates DOCX, PDF and cover letter per job
Step 6 of 8

Pre-fill the answers

Screening questions are answered from your saved details, and anything uncertain is held for you to confirm.

  • Work authorisation, notice period, salary
  • Free-text guesses produce warnings, not silent answers
  • Every answer is visible before submission
Step 7 of 8

Dry run first

A dry run opens the real application form read-only, fills every field and stops. The submit button is never clicked.

  • Shows exactly what would be sent
  • Network requests that could send data are blocked
  • Catches missing fields before the real thing
Step 8 of 8

Approve and submit

After you approve, the agent submits and records the employer’s confirmation reference as proof.

  • Submitted with reference TP-5001
  • Status only flips to SUBMITTED when verified
  • Everything exportable as CSV, JSON or HTML
